input.code:
import cadquery as cq

# PARAMETERS
leg_long = 60.0      # mm - long leg length
leg_short = 40.0     # mm - short leg length
width = 20.0         # mm - bracket width (both legs)
thick = 4.0          # mm - bracket thickness
screw_d = 3.2        # mm - M3 clearance hole (3mm + 0.2mm clearance)

# Build L-bracket from 2D sketch, extruded in Z
# Print orientation: flat on build plate (L-shape in XY, Z up)
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(leg_long, 0)
    .lineTo(leg_long, width)
    .lineTo(width, width)        # inner corner of the L
    .lineTo(width, leg_short)
    .lineTo(0, leg_short)
    .close()
    .extrude(thick)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([
        (leg_long - 10, width / 2),   # long leg, 10mm from free end
        (width / 2, leg_short - 7),    # short leg, 7mm from free end
        (width / 2, 20),               # short leg, midway
    ])
    .hole(screw_d)
)
